primary: coding ood: mathematics+physics to coding with four target training tasks
decision: All gates required for GO to independent confirmation only; otherwise NO-GO for scaling this mechanism. No retuning or extra runs.
budget: Every fit uses 120 updates of exactly 32 candidates (replacement sampling), same architecture and learning rate. Domain-only uses the same four target tasks throughout; shared uses other-domain training tasks for first 60 steps, then the same four target tasks for 60 steps. Randomized auxiliary uses identical source rows with within-domain label permutations. Domain input dimensions differ, so measured time and costs remain reported.
scope: Fresh development pilot only. Math endpoint is local digit/carry transition correctness, not full arithmetic task correctness. Coding OOD changes sum to count; physics OOD doubles planning horizon; math OOD introduces incoming carry/borrow. Historical specialists may have prior exposure to generic structures. No final generalization claim.
architecture: Separate fixed public domain encodings and domain-specific 16-unit trainable input projections; shared 16-to-8-to-1 evaluator. All conditions have identical architecture and initialization. Auxiliary gradients update shared layers and source projections only; target projection receives four target tasks. No private results in encodings.
